products.title: Cable Knit Polo Burgundy
products.body_html:
Crafted from ultra-fine merino wool sourced from the first shearing, this cable-knit polo delivers exceptional softness, warmth, and natural breathability. Lightly brushed for a subtle, lived-in texture, it features a cable-knit body accented by thicker ribbing at the sleeve cuffs and hem for refined structure. It also features an oversized 70s/80s inspired collar with a deep clean placket and natural mother-of-pearl buttons.

 

Designed with a relaxed, slightly cropped silhouette, it nods to classic knits worn by icons of past decades. Ideal for layering year-round, whether over a tee/polo on cool summer mornings or under outerwear in colder months.

products.title: Instructors Jacket Navy
products.body_html:
Introducing our INSTRUCTORS Jacket. Inspired by the jackets worn by golf instructors throughout the ’90s, this blouson features a rounded stand-up collar (foldable), a two-way zip closure with a buttoned placket, and antique brass hardware for a vintage feel. An elastic hem and adjustable cuffs create the signature boxy and slightly cropped fit.

The jacket is unlined and includes both interior and hidden zip pockets for added functionality. Front belly flap pockets with hidden zippers enhance practicality and everyday utility. Crafted from a soft, water-repellent cotton blend, it’s designed to move with you whether on the golf course, off-duty, or anywhere in between. Featuring a patterned trim lining the inside placket, collar and pockets for a touch of nostalgic charm. A design rooted in golf, crafted for everyday life. Shown here in a Deep Navy.

Finished with our signature buckle and hardware, the DOUBLE LOOP Belt is detailed with tapered edges and a tonal inner lining, allowing it to age gracefully over time.

products.title: Double Pleat Slacks Taupe
products.body_html:
Tailored from breathable Italian four-season wool, our DOUBLE PLEATED SLACKS feature a full straight-leg and generous outward facing double pleats for ease of wear and handsome drape. Featuring an unlined on seam buttoned waistband and slanted side pockets for practicality and style. 

 

Wool’s breathable, moisture-resistant qualities make these a delight to wear, whether you’re seated in a sky rise or lining up putts all day. They also recover from creases with ease, balancing comfort and refinement throughout your day.

products.title: Ribbed Jersey Polo Taupe
products.body_html: Our RIBBED POLO is based on the iconic jersey golf polos of the late 90’s and early ‘00s. Featuring distinct details such as a contrast stripe ribbed collar, a ribbed sleeve cuff, clean placket and oversized buttons for a bold, nostalgic touch. Crafted from a substantial cotton-viscose blend, the fabric offers rich texture and a soft, natural drape that moves effortlessly with the body.
